Overview

About Velocity Fund

Velocity Fund is a Government of India initiative to provide early-stage capital to deep tech startups so they can move from research and prototype to scalable products. It targets technologies where long development cycles make private capital hard to raise.

Selected startups receive funding of up to ₹9 Crore, structured as equity support of up to 75% of the approved project cost, along with mentorship and access to industry networks. Focus areas include AI and machine learning, robotics, quantum computing, semiconductors, clean energy and space technology.

Key benefits

  • Early-stage funding of up to ₹9 Crore to fuel innovation and growth
  • Equity support of up to 75% of the project cost
  • Expert mentorship from industry specialists and investor networks
  • Positions the startup for global competitiveness
  • Complements DPIIT benefits, Fund of Funds and CGSS

Who is eligible

  • Deep tech startup working on future technologies
  • Incorporated as a private limited company in India
  • Recognised by DPIIT under Startup India
  • Defensible technology or IP with global potential
  • Founding team with the technical capability to execute

Documents required

  • Certificate of incorporation and DPIIT recognition
  • Pitch deck, technology note and development roadmap
  • Project cost breakdown and use of funds
  • Founder profiles and cap table
  • Patents, publications or proof of concept results (if any)
